To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the contribution of household subsistence production to rural livelihoods in Bulgaria and Romania is of utmost importance and that the contribution of the household subsistence production is significant for the rural poor households in all five new EU Member State.

1) subsistence agriculture is a key livelihood strategy for rural people in Bulgaria and Romania, 2) the value of subsidence production is of utmost importance to rural people in these countries, 3) there is a strong relationship between the value of subsistene production and poverty, and 4) there are significant differences between households in terms of the contribution of the subsistence production to their real household income.

(1) subsistence production is important for rural households in all of the five countries; (2) subsistence production plays a significant role in the rural economy of Bulgaria and Romania; (3) subsistence production has the largest impact on household incomes in Bulgaria and Romania; and (4) the contribution of subsistance production to household incomes varies considerably between the countries.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the following questions: How does the contribution of subsistance production to agricultural household incomes vary across five new Member States?
the following questions: What is the contribution of subsistance farming to household incomes?
the contribution of subsidence production to the rural household incomes in the new EU Member States.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
subsistence production is a major source of food security and income for the rural poor in the new EU Member States.
subsistence production in the five countries is a significant source of income, and is likely to remain important in the medium term.
, for the rural poor of the five countries, the value of their subsistence production to their real household incomes is of great importance.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
subsistence production is an important part of rural livelihoods, and it is likely to persist as an important component of the rural economy for some time to come.

the contribution of the subsistence production to the rural households' income is significant, and that the importance of the subsistence farming in the new EU Member States should not be underestimated.
the contribution of agriculture to household incomes is much higher than official statistics suggest and that the contribution of the subsistence sector to rural incomes is significant.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the contribution of agriculture to the rural economy is not only about the production and sale of marketable commodities, but also includes subsistence production and the provision of services.
subsistence farming is a significant source of food security, income and employment for rural poor households in the five new Member States.
subsistence agriculture should not be ignored when evaluating poverty and vulnerability in rural areas.
